initialExam.title: NEET MDS 2026
initialExam.description: National Eligibility cum Entrance Test for Master of Dental Surgery (MDS) admissions. Exam held 2 May 2026; result declared 2 Jun 2026. Counselling in progress.
initialExam.qualifications: BDS degree + Completion of internship + Valid dental registration
initialExam.syllabus: All BDS subjects: Oral Medicine & Radiology (Oral Pathology, Diagnosis, Radiographic Interpretation), Prosthodontics (Complete/Partial/Fixed Dentures, Implantology), Conservative Dentistry & Endodontics (Dental Materials, Operative, Pulp Biology), Orthodontics (Cephalometrics, Biomechanics, Appliances), Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery (Trauma, TMJ, Infections, Cysts & Tumors), Periodontics, Pedodontics, Public Health Dentistry (Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Preventive Programs).
initialExam.examPattern: Single Paper CBT: 240 MCQs, 960 marks, 180 minutes. No negative marking. Questions from all dental subjects combined.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Computer Based Test (CBT) → Counselling (AIQ/State Quota) → Document Verification → Admission to MDS Course

salaryRange.description: Entrance exam - no salary (Post-MDS specialists earn Pay Level 10+ in govt service)

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: No age limit for appearing in NEET MDS

initialExam.perks: Post-MDS as Dental Specialist: DA, HRA, NPA (Non-Practicing Allowance in some states), Medical, Pension
initialExam.careerGrowth: MDS → Senior Resident → Assistant Professor → Associate Professor → Professor → Dean/Principal. In private: Specialist Dental Practitioner.
initialExam.jobRole: Admission to MDS programs for specialization in Orthodontics, Prosthodontics, Oral Surgery, Periodontics, Endodontics, Pedodontics, and other dental disciplines.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit natboard.edu.in 2. Register on NEET MDS portal 3. Fill application form 4. Upload photo, signature & documents 5. Pay fee 6. Submit
